title: Parcels (TMK)
desc: Generalized tax map key parcels near Kahului with assessment attributes. This extract is not a legal boundary or a complete county dataset.

title: County zoning
desc: Zoning districts under Maui County Code Title 19, with zone code and district name.

title: State land use districts
desc: Urban, Agricultural, Conservation and Rural districts set by the State Land Use Commission under HRS Chapter 205.

title: Special management area
desc: Coastal special management area administered by the County under HRS Chapter 205A. Development inside it needs an SMA permit or exemption.

title: Wailuku-Kahului community plan (2002)
desc: Community plan land use designations for the Wailuku-Kahului community plan area, adopted 2002.

title: Maui Island Plan growth boundaries
desc: Urban, rural and small town growth boundaries from the Maui Island Plan (2012), directed growth map.

title: Maui Island Plan protected areas
desc: Greenways, park lands and other protected areas from the Maui Island Plan (2012).

title: FEMA flood hazard zones (DFIRM)
desc: Digital flood insurance rate map zones (A, AE, AO, VE, X) for Maui County, with special flood hazard area flag.

title: Tsunami evacuation zones
desc: Tsunami evacuation zone, extreme tsunami evacuation zone and safe zone for Kahului and Wailuku.

title: Sea-level rise exposure area, 3.2 ft
desc: Area exposed to chronic flooding with 3.2 feet of sea-level rise (passive flooding, annual high wave flooding and coastal erosion).

title: Evacuation shelters
desc: Potential emergency shelters with address, capacity where known, pet-friendly and special-needs flags.

title: Fire stations
desc: Fire stations with station name and status.

title: Road centerlines
desc: Road centerlines for Maui with street name and road class.

title: Bridges (National Bridge Inventory)
desc: Bridges with structure number, year built, traffic, deck, superstructure and substructure condition ratings.

title: Public schools
desc: Public schools with name, address, grades and school type.

title: Streams
desc: Perennial and intermittent streams with stream name and type.

title: Council districts
desc: Maui County Council residency areas with district number and name.

title: 311 service requests
desc: Service requests with type, status, department, SLA and council district. Reporter details are never published.

title: Storm drain and signal assets
desc: Storm drain inlets, culverts and traffic signals with condition score, install year and last inspection.
